paper_title: Towards Predicting Any Human Trajectory In Context
caption: Performance of random example selection and the proposed STES at varying numbers of in-context examples.
model_annotation: This line chart compares the performance of two example selection strategies—ST-ES and Random—as measured by minimum ADE₂₀ (in units of distance) across varying numbers of in-context examples, ranging from 0 to 8. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Examples,” is linearly scaled from 0 to 8 with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis, labeled “minADE₂₀ (←),” is linearly scaled from 8.80 to 10.20 with tick marks at intervals of 0.40. The ST-ES strategy is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at a value of 10.20 at 0 examples and decreasing to 8.88 at 8 examples, showing a general downward trend with minor fluctuations. The Random strategy is represented by an orange line with circular markers, starting at 9.80 at 0 examples and remaining relatively stable around 9.40 to 9.60 for the remainder of the range, with minor fluctuations.
